title: 2 August 1964: Live: Gaumont Cinema, Bournemouth
content:
On 2 August 1964 The Beatles returned to Bournemouth’s Gaumont Cinema, following their six-night residency at the venue from 19–24 August 1963.

The Beatles topped a bill which also featured The Kinks, Mike Berry and Adrienne Poster.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024
